listing:
Pet-friendly sublet! Room on Hazel St — $740 — Jan 1–Apr 30

Absolutely no 'no pets' nonsense here, our whole house loves animals: we've got a cat (Biscuit) and you are welcome to bring a cat, small dog, hamster, whatever, as long as you clean up after them. 4 min walk to UW. Own room, utilities incl, 2 housemates. House is at 108 Hazel St, Waterloo, you can swing by for a visit any day after 5 (and meet Biscuit!). The landlord is aware and OK with the sublet, and said we can't ban pets anyway lol. Rent on the 1st by e-transfer.
label_rationale: Negative control: the text mentions 'no pets' only to reject it and welcomes pets, consistent with RTA s.14 ('A provision in a tenancy agreement prohibiting the presence of animals in or about the residential complex is void'). There is no pet-ban clause, so no_pets must not fire. Consent (s.97(1)), address, viewing, normal rent. ADMIT. Uncertainty: low; difficulty is purely negation handling.
